results.title: First-mile chilling solved; no stated monitoring for the transport and processing legs
results.closest_fact_claim: Hatsun deploys Active Bulk Coolers (ABC) at more than 1,100 village-level locations for instant chilling of milk within 2 hours of collection.

results.title: Multi-state, multi-district network with no unified real-time view
results.closest_fact_claim: Hatsun operates chilling centres in more than 68 locations with over 1,348 contract vehicles, milk sheds across 10 districts in Tamil Nadu and 3 districts in Karnataka, and 20 manufacturing plants across 7 states as of 2025.
